act.name: Narcotic Drugs and Psychotropic Substances Act, 1985
act.source_authority: Department of Revenue, Ministry of Finance, Government of India
act.description: Central criminal law regulating narcotic drugs and psychotropic substances, offences, search, bail, treatment and forfeiture.

sections.title: Offences to be cognizable and non-bailable.
sections.text: Section 37 concerns cognizability, non-bailability and statutory bail restrictions for specified NDPS offences; consult the linked official text for the complete provision.
sections.plain_language_summary: Specified NDPS offences have special, stringent bail conditions in addition to ordinary criminal-procedure requirements.
